lines: 0:00–0:02 A barber stands behind a seated, caped client, both facing the mirror with shop signage behind them. The barber's fingers are on the client's hairline at the nape. Nothing moves. Ambient shop noise of chatter and a clipper.
0:02–0:04 The client's jaw, ear, and bare neckline fill the view, with visible marks on the skin. Room noise.
0:04–0:06 The client's jaw and ear. The barber runs clippers, tapering the sideburn past the ear. Close, loud clipper buzz.
0:06–0:08 The client's neck and jawline. The barber sprays a clear water bottle two or three times, mist visible in the air. Two or three sharp spray sounds.
0:08–0:10 The barber holds the WIDGET™ up, completely still, label readable, with the shop blurred behind it. Silence.
0:10–0:12 A patch of the client's neck. The barber runs the WIDGET™ over the patch in slow passes back and forth, the device visibly on. Low hum of the device against skin.
0:12–0:15 The barber snaps the cape off. The client stands up, looking straight ahead with his chin lifted, neck visible. Sound of the cape snapping, then shop noise.
0:15–0:18 The barber and client do a handshake and half-hug, then the client walks away. Sound of the dap and shop chatter.

0:18–0:21 The barber is alone at the station, holding the WIDGET™ and standing still. Shop chatter and clippers in the background. On-screen text: "nobody's neck clears in one cut. / it's one thing. on the part that actually bumps." and "@brand-a".

0:21–0:25 The barber stands motionless, looking at the WIDGET™ in his hand. Shop chatter continues. On-screen text: "WIDGET™ — $69.99 / 90 days. If your skin doesn't transform, full refund. You keep the WIDGET™." and "@brand-a".
